title: ID0445781-DC/SI-D/AT-[RVP / T3 170004541] Metal cover in wrong color & missing cable glands
description:
Reported issue:
The fan cover, base, cable entry for power supply, cable entry for
dispenser, and lock were delivered in white instead of grey. The
cable grommets for the main power supply (9x M40, 2x M20, 1x
M25) were missing.
Solution: NA
yyyy-mm-dd: NA
Note: charger is working fine, contact Serviceability Manager to organize the missing parts delivery
